s1.syndrome_frame: Bilateral ocular inflammation with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Bilateral blurred vision and ocular irritation
Stromal immune ring formation with underlying keratic precipitates
key_facts: Patient is a teenage girl from Saint-Martin
Presented with bilateral blurred vision and ocular irritation
Experienced fever and severe arthralgia one month earlier
Neurological complications are present
Recently acquired periorbital hyperpigmentation
Ocular history is negative for trauma and previous inflammation
Primary HIV infection, tuberculosis, sarcoidosis, and syphilis have been ruled out
Best-corrected visual acuity is 20/20 OU
Slitlamp biomicroscopy revealed bilateral punctate superficial keratitis and stromal immune ring formation
Aqueous tap PCR results are positive for Chikungunya virus with weak viral load
IgM CHIKV serologic test is positive
